title: A shell inside the word for money

probes.question: What did the Classical Chinese character for "money" originate as a drawing of?
True or false: the cedi, Ghana's national currency introduced in 1965, was named after cowrie shells.

image.alt: A pale money cowrie shell (Monetaria moneta) shown from several sides on a black background

body.claim: The Classical Chinese character for "money" (貝) originated as a stylized drawing of a Maldivian cowrie shell.
body.why: Starting more than 3000 years ago, cowrie shells or their copies were used as Chinese currency. Words and characters concerning money, property, or wealth usually have this as a radical.
